scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on his account and requesting a potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is DeShawn Jefferson and I'm 45. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Hello DeShawn, I can certainly help you look into that charge. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the last four digits of the card that was charged?
Sure, my account number is 88492011 and the card ends in 4492.
Thank you. Just to be absolutely sure, can you also confirm your date of birth for me?

Thanks. I see the $76 charge here from 'Global Market Services'. It doesn't look like a standard merchant we usually see. I'm going to go ahead and open a formal dispute for this transaction per our Fraud Protection Policy, which requires us to investigate any unauthorized activity reported by the account holder.
Okay, that sounds right. Does that mean I get my money back now?

Well, the dispute process takes some time to investigate. I've initiated the case, and you should see a temporary credit in your account within 3-5 business days while our team reviews the merchant details. If they confirm it's fraudulent, the credit becomes permanent.

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's identity, identified the transaction, and initiated a formal dispute process with a temporary credit issued.
